h: Finding the Hidden Light Within Oral Torah

p: בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (דְּבָרִים רַבָּה א, יט)
In the Midrash Rabbah on this parshah (Devarim Rabbah 1:19):
רַב לָכֶם סוֹב אֶת הָהָר הַזֶּה
"'You have circled this mountain long enough;
And where shall we flee? etc.
'He stores up sound wisdom for the upright.'"
For the Torah is called "tzafonah," hidden,
was hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh,
the light that was created on the first day.
וְהַיֵּצֶר הָרָע גַּם כֵּן נִקְרָא צְפוֹנִי
And the yetzer hara is also called "Tzefoni"
for it is hidden and stands
meaning that the yetzer hara is able
and to entice a person and mislead him,
to set darkness before him as light,
"And it sits between the two openings of the heart"
אַף בְּלֵב חָכָם לִימִינוֹ (קֹהֶלֶת י, ב)
even in "the heart of the wise man at his right" (Koheles 10:2);
for at times it conceals itself
as though showing him the good way,
like "the heart of the wise man at his right."
וְזֶה עִנְיָן שֶׁנִּזְכַּר כָּאן בַּפָּרָשָׁה (דְּבָרִים ב, ד)
And this is the matter mentioned here in the parshah (Devarim 2:4):
through the border of your brothers, the sons of Esav," etc.;
Why is the brotherhood mentioned here?
Granted, there, in the mission to him,
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה
according to what is written in the Midrash Rabbah
(בַּמִּדְבַּר רַבָּה יט, טו; רַשִׁ״י בַּמִּדְבַּר כ, יד)
against whom a promissory note was issued," etc.;
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הָאֲרִ״י הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what the holy Arizal wrote
"He takes his own portion and his fellow's portion
and "he takes his own portion and his fellow's portion
has one soul corresponding to him
among the nations of the world;
and from this comes the "leaven in the dough"
in the heart of a Jew,
that there is in him some evil as well.
And correspondingly there is in the wicked one
who is of the nations of the world
a little of the good as well,
"And You give life to them all";
and this one must extract from him.
And this is the meaning of the pasuk (Malachi 1:2):
"Is not Esav a brother to Yaakov?"
וְעַל זֶה בִּיקֵּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית לב, יב)
And about this Yaakov Avinu asked (Bereishis 32:12):
הַצִּילֵנִי נָא מִיַּד אָחִי מִיַּד עֵשָׂו
"Save me, please, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esav"
meaning, from what he has toward me
And the matter is according to what is written
concerning the three hundred and ten worlds:
"Two hundred and seven are on the right side,
one hundred and three are on the left side," etc.
And there in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 167a):
for from the right came forth the left, etc.
'And there was light' — this is the left, etc.;
and from it came forth that darkness, etc.
וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו אִישׁ יוֹדֵעַ צַיִד וְכוּלֵּי
'And Esav was a man who knew hunting,' etc.,
so that they not walk in a straight path," etc.
That is: from the right side,
207 is the numerical value of "or," light,
corresponding to the five Chumashim of the Torah."
and it is brought from the holy Arizal
that it is the numerical value of "minchah le'Esav," a gift to Esav.
to those who go leftward in it, for evil,
"and the heart of a fool at his left."
That is, in Torah she'b'al peh
for those who go leftward in it as well,
that he would show facets not in accordance with halachah,
that the calves are, chas v'shalom,
which is the subject of Toras Kohanim
bring out the light from within the darkness
"for from the right came forth the left,"
and from there one brings out the primordial light,
which is "Let there be light" from the right.
as is written in the Tanchuma:
"the light that was created on the first day."

p: will be revealed in the future, in the days of Mashiach.
And about this it says in the Midrash Rabbah
which You have hidden away for those who fear You.'"
For the essential light of Torah she'b'al peh
is hidden away for the time to come;
only on Shabbos is there revealed
a semblance of the World to Come,
as is written in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its place,
and the rest was hidden away for the tzaddikim," etc.
"who are called Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג כט, ב)
to them there is revealed every day
and as is written in the holy Zohar
that they bring out the light
"'He has set me in dark places'
this is the Talmud of Bavel."
וְעֵשָׂו הָיָה בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן נִיצוֹץ
And Esav too had in him a spark
of the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
that he had in him the soul of Rabbi Meir,
the root of Torah she'b'al peh.
And about this it says in the Midrash Rabbah
"There is wisdom in Edom — believe it;
There is Torah — do not believe it,
'among the nations, there is no Torah,'" etc.
That is: even though they have
does not teach them the good way;
for it is called "Torah" on this account,
that it teaches the way of Hashem.
As we find with Haman's wise men,
of his family, of the sons of Esav;
that one who says a word of wisdom,
even among the nations of the world,
וְהַיְינוּ בְּמַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בָּזֶה הָאֱמֶת (אֶסְתֵּר ו, יג)
That is, in that they told the truth in this (Esther 6:13):
"If he is of the seed of the Jews," etc.,
for they arrived at the truth.
the wisdom did not instruct him
he still wanted to hang him.
And this is because their wisdom
from which this darkness came forth:
so that they not walk in a straight path,
And this is what we find
שֶׁכְּתַלְמִיד חָכָם נִדְמָה לוֹ (חוּלִּין צא, א)
that "he appeared to him as a talmid chacham" (Chullin 91a):
he made himself appear to Yaakov
as one who shows him the good way,
and he wanted to make darkness into light;
and he said that he held on to him
who shows him the way of Hashem.
But he could not prevail over him,
for it is hidden in a person's heart,
for it hides and conceals itself
so that he thinks he is doing a mitzvah.
And at the time of the Giving of the Torah
"And He shone forth to them from Se'ir"
for they took from Esav the radiance
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קצב, ב)
And in the days of Mashiach
there will be revealed the entire essence
of the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
which You have hidden away," etc.
to judge the mountain of Esav"
that they will extract all the sparks of holiness
and all the merit he had
and then "there will be no remnant
'He stores up sound wisdom for the upright'";
and this is Torah she'b'al peh,
And this is "He stores up for the upright"
which is hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh,
as is written in the Tanchuma:
and it is from the "dew of Atika."
And on Shabbos there is a revelation
as is written in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its place."
